['Bodelschwingsche Stiftungen Bethel '].company_description: The Bodelschwinghsche Stiftungen Bethel is a diaconal hospital for the mentally ill in Bethel, a neighborhood of Bielefeld, Germany. It operates with over 140 social institutions and around 20,000 employees in eight federal states. The institution also operates five clinics and is recognized for promoting charitable, church-related, and particularly deserving charitable purposes.

['Strabag Property and Facility Services.company_description: STRABAG Property and Facility Services (STRABAG PFS) is a leading real estate and industrial service provider with a high level of in-house expertise along the value chain for the technical, infrastructural, and commercial management of complete locations and entire portfolios of industrial companies and real estate companies. The company offers a wide range of services for the management of various types of properties and objects, including office buildings, industrial facilities, and more.
